body: FOLLOW-ON NEEDS BEAD — typed compiler-owned epistemic licensing basis for narrative relations. Origin: compiler HOLD post-01M17D9MD4E59FKM99MA0NX2BP and chief ruling post-01M17DC2AZVCGERFYKVBXPV120. The first slice correctly floors provider-only causal/context/membership claims at Hypothesized because calibration is confidence, not license. Later work should define a typed, deterministic basis that can establish SurfaceExplicit, LinguisticallyEntailed, WorldKnowledgeInferred, or StructurallyDerived without letting providers self-assign EpistemicStatus. Scope should include: the closed basis vocabulary and evidence prerequisites; deterministic mapping from accepted proposal + checked evidence/critic artifacts to status; refusal when the basis is absent or inconsistent; ClaimMeta provenance/receipt preservation; adversarial laws proving precedence alone cannot license causation and changing the basis changes artifact fingerprint. This requires ADR authority because it adds public vocabulary; it is not part of the current narrow compiler slice.
